title: LORD, SHIELD MY FAMILY FROM EVERY ARROW OF DARKNESS
text: Glory to God. I want you to lift [music] up your hands wherever you are right now. Whether you're watching this from your home, from your office, from wherever the Lord has positioned you at this moment, I want you to understand that this is not an accident. The fact that you are hearing [music] this word right now is divine orchestration. The spirit of the living God has called you into this moment because there is a cry that has been rising from your heart and heaven has sent an answer. I want us to go into the place of deep intercession this evening. But before [music] we pray, I need to establish some things in your spirit. You see, when we talk about the shield [music] of God covering our families, we are not just making empty declarations. We are engaging spiritual laws [music] that have been established from the foundation of the world. The Bible says in Psalm 91, he that [music] dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. This is not poetry. This is a spiritual constitution that governs how protection operates in the realm of the [music] spirit. Now I need you to understand something about the arrows of darkness. When the scripture [music] talks about arrows, it is referring to projectiles, things that are launched from a distance with specific targets in mind. Arrows don't just fly randomly. Somebody [music] has to position them. Somebody has to aim them. Somebody has to release them. And so when we are dealing with arrows of darkness, we are dealing with calculated intentional demonic assignments that have been fired toward your bloodline, [music] toward your children, toward your marriage, toward your health, toward your destiny. But I prophesy to somebody right now, every [music] arrow that has been fired against your household, I decree and declare by the authority of the name of Jesus [music] Christ, they will not locate their target. Every arrow that is in flight right now searching for your children, I command them to miss their mark in the mighty name of Jesus. Every arrow of infirmity, [music] every arrow of financial collapse, every arrow of marital destruction, every arrow of sudden death, I decree that the blood of Jesus has canled their assignment. You see, the enemy knows that if [music] he can destroy the family unit, he can destroy nations. This is why there is such a concentrated attack against families in [music] this generation. The institution of the family was the first institution that God established before he established the church, before he established governments, he established the family. And anything that God establishes [music] first becomes the primary target of satanic attack. This is why we cannot afford to be casual about the protection of our families. Let me take you to Ephesians chapter 6 and I want to read from verse 10. The Bible says, "Finally, my brethren, be strong in [music] the Lord and in the power of his might. Put on the whole armor of God that ye may be able to stand against the ws of the devil. For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places." Now, I want you to notice something. Paul says put on the whole armor. He didn't say put on part of it. He didn't say pick and choose what [music] you like. He said the whole armor. And you know why? Because the enemy studies where you are not covered. The devil is looking for your areas of vulnerability. He's looking for where you have not applied the blood. He's looking for where you have not spoken the word. He's looking [music] for the gaps in your spiritual fortification. And so when we talk about the shield of faith, understand that [music] this is not just a decorative accessory. The shield in ancient warfare [music] was a defensive weapon that was designed to absorb and extinguish flaming arrows. The Roman shield that Paul was referring to was large enough to cover the entire [music] body of a soldier. It was made of wood and covered with leather. And before battle, [music] soldiers would soak it in water so that when fiery darts came, they would be immediately extinguished. Now apply this spiritually. When your faith is soaked in the water [music] of the word of God, when your faith has been saturated in the presence of the Holy Spirit, when your faith has been activated through prayer and fasting, then when the enemy launches his fiery darts and he will launch them, your faith becomes a quenching [music] mechanism. Your faith doesn't just block the attack. It extinguishes the very fire that was meant to consume you. Can I tell you what the arrows of darkness [music] look like? They come in different forms. Sometimes they come as sudden sickness that has no medical explanation. Doctors run tests and find nothing but the person continues to deterate. That is an arrow. [music] Sometimes it comes as unexplainable fear that grips your children at night. Your child was perfectly fine and suddenly they cannot sleep. They are having nightmares. They are saying things that is an arrow. Sometimes it comes as a spirit of division in your marriage. You and your spouse were [music] flowing together and suddenly there is constant friction, constant misunderstanding, constant conflict. That is an arrow. Sometimes these arrows manifest [music] as financial strangulation. Your business was flourishing and [music] suddenly everything you touch begins to collapse. Your income streams begin to dry up for no logical reason. That is an arrow. Sometimes it comes as a spirit of rebellion in your children. [music] Your children were obedient and suddenly they become strangers to you. They begin to keep secrets. They begin to walk in paths that you never taught them. That is an arrow. Sometimes it [music] comes as premature death, as accidents that were orchestrated from the pit of hell. These are arrows. But I want to prophesy to you right now. The Lord is raising up a generation of believers who will not be victims. We will not sit down and watch the enemy [music] destroy what God has given us to steward. We are taking our place in the the realm of militant [music] intercession. We are learning how to wage warfare in the place of prayer. We are learning how to bind and to lose. We are learning how to call fire from heaven upon [music] every satanic altar that has been raised against our families. Let me show you something in 2 Kings chapter 6. There was a time when the king of Syria was making war against Israel. [music] And every strategy he made, the prophet Elisha would reveal it to the king [music] of Israel. The Syrian king became so frustrated that he thought there was a spy among his servants. But one of his servants said,"None, my lord, O king, but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, tellth the king of Israel, the words that thou speakest in thy bed chamber." Do you see what I want you to catch? The prophet had access to classified [music] information. He could hear what was being planned in the secret chambers of the enemy. And this is the dimension that God is calling families into in this season. the dimension of prophetic intelligence where you begin to know what the enemy is planning before he executes it. Where the Holy Spirit begins to show you things to come, where you begin to have dreams that are warnings, where you begin to have checks in your spirit that are not paranoia but prophetic sensitivity. And so the Syrian king sent his army to capture Elisha. The Bible says they came by night and surrounded the city. Early in the morning, Elisha's servant went out and saw that the entire [music] city was surrounded by horses and chariots. He came back in fear and said, "Alas, my master, what shall we do?" But I love the response of the prophet. Elisha said, "Fear not, for they that be with us are more than they that be with them." Now, from the natural eye, this statement made no sense. It was just Elisha and his servant and they were surrounded by an entire army. But Elisha [music] was operating from a different dimension of sight. He was not looking at what was visible. He was looking at what was real. And there is a difference. Everything that is [music] visible is not necessarily real. And everything that is real is not necessarily visible. [music] And so Elisha prayed, "Lord, I pray thee, open his eyes that he may see." And the Lord opened the eyes of the young man and he saw. And behold, the mountain was full of [music] horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. You see, the moment God opened his eyes to see into [music] the spirit realm, he discovered that they were not outnumbered. They were surrounded by the armies of heaven. And I prophesy to somebody, if God would open your [music] eyes right now to see into the realm of the spirit, you would see that your family is not defenseless. You would see that there are angels that have been assigned to your household. You would see that there is a hedge of fire around your children. He wants you to focus on the financial statement. He wants you to focus on what your children are doing wrong. Because as [music] long as you are focused on the natural, you will live in fear. Suddenly you move from being a victim into being a victor. Now I want to take you to the place of prayer. But before we pray, there are some scriptures [music] I need you to hide in your heart. Psalm 127:1 says, "Except the Lord build the house, they labor in vain that build it, except the [music] Lord keep the city, the watchmen wicked but in vain." Do you see what [music] the scripture is saying? Every arrow, every trap, every snare, [music] every plot, every scheme, he shall preserve you from all of it. This is not a suggestion. This is a covenant declaration. This is the word of the living God, and it [music] cannot fail. Now, there is something else I need to show you. In Isaiah 54 from verse 15, the Bible says, "Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me. Whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake. Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the [music] coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work, and I have created the waster to destroy. God is saying, I have created the smith that makes [music] the weapons, and I have created the waster that destroys. Do you know what God is saying? He's saying [music] even the person that is manufacturing weapons against you, I am the one who gave them the ability to manufacture. And if I gave them the ability, I [music] can withdraw it. If I allow them to forge that weapon, I can render it powerless. This is why the scripture says, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper." It didn't say no weapon would be formed. Weapons will be formed. The enemy will craft strategies [music] against your family, but the promise is not that they won't be formed. The promise is that they shall not [music] prosper. They will be formed but they will fail. They will be launched but they will not reach their target. They will be activated but they will malfunction in the name of Jesus. I need you to understand the power of this promise. When God says no weapon, he's not just [music] talking about swords and speares. He's talking about every form of spiritual weaponry. Witchcraft is a [music] weapon. It shall not prosper. Curses are weapons. They shall not prosper. Evil covenants are weapons. [music] they shall not prosper. Monitoring spirits are weapons. They shall not prosper. Inherited bondages are weapons. [music] They shall not prosper. And not only shall the weapons not prosper, but the Bible says, "Every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." This means that even the [music] words that people speak against you, even the negative prophecies, even the evil declarations, even the gossip, even the curses [music] that they pronounce with their mouths, you have been given the authority to condemn them. You are not a victim of [music] people's words. You have the power to nullify and cancel every negative word that has been spoken against [music] your family. Can I teach you something about spiritual warfare? One of the most powerful weapons that we have been given is the weapon of declaration. The Bible says in Job 22:28, [music] "Thou shalt also decree a thing and it shall be established unto thee and the light shall shine upon thy ways." When you decree a thing, you are not hoping it will happen. You are establishing it in the realm [music] of the spirit. You are legislating. You are creating realities with your words. This is why the enemy fights so hard to keep believers [music] silent. He doesn't want you to open your mouth. He doesn't want you to speak the word. He doesn't want you to make declarations over your family because he knows that [music] the moment you begin to speak with authority, you begin to shift things in the spirit realm. The moment you begin to prophesy over your children, [music] you are programming their destiny. The moment you begin to speak protection over your home, you are activating angelic presence. Now, let me show you something about the blood of Jesus. In Exodus 12, when the children of Israel were about to be delivered from Egypt, God instructed [music] them to take the blood of a lamb and apply to the doorpost of their houses. And he said, "When I see the blood, I will pass over you and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you." Now, this was not just an Old Testament [music] story. This was a prophetic picture of what Jesus Christ would do for us. Jesus is the lamb of God that taketh [music] away the sin of the world. And his blood is not just for the forgiveness of sins. His blood is for protection. His blood is a shield. His blood [music] is a covering. His blood speaks better things than the blood of Abel.
